name: Tamil Nadu RERA
note: Public 'Projects on Map' page: certificate no., name/address, promoter-declared GPS point and project-details link for every building project registered this year (2026, the page's default). Project-details page + Form A (project and promoter) read for each candidate. robots.txt disallows only /uploads/ and PDFs, which were not read (so BHK types from the carpet-area statement PDF are not collected). The page's year filter (2024/2025) needs a form post with a session token; that request was blocked by the Claude Code auto-mode bot-check rule and was not attempted again.
